mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders_products ( order_id, product_id, quantity, price ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{price} )
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.user_id AS userId, o.ordered_at AS purchaseDate, op.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, op.quantity, op.price AS price FROM orders o JOIN orders_products op ON o.id = op.order_id JOIN products p ON op.product_id = p.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC
